title: TikTok User Search Scraper
description: TikTok User Search Scraper collects structured data from Scrappa's /tiktok/user/search endpoint. Submit multiple inputs in one Actor run and receive one dataset item per result. Submit multiple batch entries in one run.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Batch input entries. Each keywords is sent as the keywords value.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search text for public TikTok users. Use a username fragment, brand name, creator niche, product category, or campaign keyword.

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of user matches to return for the page, up to 50.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Pass this value with the same `keywords` query when `hasMore` is true.

maxPages.description: Maximum pages to request for each batch entry.
